senses.gloss: צִידֵּד (denom. of צַד) to turn sideways, move aside; to arrange.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:11">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>מְצַדֵּד</he> man can look sideways (which other animals cannot); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:11">ib.</cite> s. 14.
<cite ref="Yoma 55a:1">Yoma 55ᵃ</cite> <he>כשהוא מזה למעלה מצדד ידו וכ׳</he> when he is to sprinkle upwards, he turns first his hand down &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 102b:4">Sabb. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>המצדד את האבן</he> he who turns a building stone (makes room for it and sets it in its place).
<cite ref="Beitzah 32b:13">Bets. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>מותר לצַדְּדָן</he> you are permitted to arrange them for a seat; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְצוּדָּד</he>, pl. <he>מְצוּדָּדִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 99a">B. Bath. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>ומצ׳ פניהם וכ׳</he> their faces were turned sideways, like a disciple taking leave of his teacher.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">Ruth R. to II, 14</cite> (play on <cite ref="M02267"><he>מִצּד</he></cite> <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">ib.</cite>) <he>שנוֹצַדָּה לו … לשעה</he> his government was taken away from him for a time.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">Ib.</cite> <he>שעתידה מלכותו לִיצַּד ממנו וכ׳</he> his government was destined to be taken away &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:7">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> <he>שיִּצּוֹד</he>, v. <cite ref="R00102"><he>צָדָה</he> II</cite>.
